study: W3-A 200 ms causal whole-body reference forecasting
mean_selection: final finite checkpoint at 180 updates; separately report validation and frozen test
rollout_conditions: Only last 8 observed reference poses in a last-observed-pelvis frame; source kick_leg left/right if recorded in PAiD, two zeros for unknown CMU. No absolute time, source ID, future measured states, force, ball, physical outcomes or inferred contact.
outputs: Future 10 frames at 50 Hz, observed-endpoint anchored 29 joints, pelvis translation and incremental SO(3) rotvec; disjoint target intervals in evaluation.
normalization: Unweighted per-channel training-window statistics only; float64 means/std, context std floor 0.05, target std floor 0.025 SI.
paired_budget: Identical training sample traces, Adam updates, batch size, split and normalized MSE. Nonlatent MLP hidden width chosen deterministically by nearest total trainable parameter count incl. CVAE posterior; count inference params separately.
primary: Mean absolute joint error (radians), mean over targets/joints, then equal weighting of complete clips, then independent model seeds. Infer from context at conditional-prior mean, no posterior.
latent_checks: Effector role groups from recorded kick_leg; unknown CMU uses anatomical left/right. Report pose/velocity limit violations and any new violation relative to same ground truth; fixed 1 mrad descriptive threshold on antithetic difference per group over 3 consecutive output frames. No torques, physics approval or human contact labels.
parameter_or_outcome_hypothesis: Only count support for a joint-forecast benefit when mean per-clip test MAE is lower than both the paired equal-parameter MLP and stronger of hold/constant-velocity for every seed. Report test clip and seed counts. Improved offline MAE and diversity alone never certify physical generalization.

paid.lineage: PAiD G1 retargets in TeleHuman/HumanoidSoccer revision e72e470230047dedaf66df0983f1d0ab746faeb5; source performer IDs and contact times unavailable

cmu.lineage: Separate W2 generated full-length 50 Hz robot reference files, derived from CMU human full-body geometry. Candidate-geometry source, independent target annotator absent; precise impact/force unavailable. Re-score no PAiD weights on CMU: fit separate models on training subject.
